parameters: Reuse original plain-arm logistic calibrators, clipping, thresholds, fixed rounds, and tie handling exactly; do not refit or reselect.

policies.fixed_forced: Answer at original frozen fixed round regardless of confidence.
policies.fixed_selective: Answer at original frozen fixed round iff calibrated confidence >= original frozen threshold; otherwise make no later answer and terminal PASS at round 5.
policies.adaptive_forced: Answer at first original frozen threshold crossing; if no crossing answer at round 5.
policies.adaptive_selective: Answer at first original frozen threshold crossing; if none terminal PASS at round 5.

inference.unit: question; all rotations, policies and menus remain paired
inference.rotation_aggregation: average the four rotations within each question before resampling
inference.conditional_error: sum wrong answers divided by sum committed answers; recompute ratio in each bootstrap sample
inference.secondary_comparisons: Other 2x2 simple effects, interaction, coverage and conditional error differences are descriptive with 95% intervals.

limitations: These 100 protocol-unexposed development questions have now been inspected; this addition is not a preregistered confirmation.
The frozen threshold and fixed round were not optimized for the new selective fixed policy.
Adaptive and fixed policies select different answer sets; the contrasts do not isolate a causal timing effect.
Forced-answer fallback is a saved-score policy change, not a new prompt or model inference.
Original game permits terminal PASS only; fixed-selective failures continue without another answer opportunity to round 5.
